inspect.digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 of canonical manifest

installation_json.purpose: Additional foreground loopback Synthetic Explorer; content identity only.

receipt_success.created: ordered array of absolute entries actually created including receipt; existing directories absent from this list
receipt_success.inputs: object keyed by exact8 source names with bytes,sha256,git_blob,device,inode,mode,uid,gid,links,mtime_ns,ctime_ns from unchanged helper
receipt_success.installed: object keyed by exact8 source names plus towerops-explorer and installation.json, same complete identity fields

error.outcome: when installation entered, partial/final outcome with same stable fields and actual phase/error; absent for inspection or preliminary argument refusal
error.console_failure: phase:console, installation_receipt:absolute receipt, selector_may_exist:true when installation completed but stdout failed

limits: Argparse syntax errors use ordinary argparse stderr/exit2; controlled input/filesystem refusals use JSON stderr/exit2. Timestamp, inode and diagnostic strings are not fixed test constants. These schemas expose existing design intentions before independent executable freeze; candidate body remains unseen by receiver.
